62606-a-mirror-of-the-turf-or-the-machin.title: Shakespeare.
62606-a-mirror-of-the-turf-or-the-machin.creator: Louis Henry Curzon,
62606-a-mirror-of-the-turf-or-the-machin.description: A book by Louis Henry Curzon,. Accustomed as we have long been to very complete records of racing, we look with some impatience on the dry fragments and supposititious statements, in which are embodied what is known regarding the birth of horse-racing. Our public journals day by day contain more in one publication than can be gathered from the historic records of the country about the horse-racing of a hundred years, when the compiler requires to carry his search back to days before good Queen Bess began to reign.

arxiv-2004-14247.title: White Paper on Broadband Connectivity in 6G
arxiv-2004-14247.creator: Nandana Rajatheva,
arxiv-2004-14247.description: Abstract Executive Summary This white paper explores the road to implementing broadband connectivity in future 6G wireless systems. Different categories of use cases are considered, from extreme capacity with peak data rates up to 1 Tbps, to raising the typical data rates by orders-of-magnitude, to support broadband connectivity at railway speeds up to 1000 km/h.

arxiv-2012-01381.title: The hot interstellar medium towards 4U 1820-30: a Bayesian analysis
arxiv-2012-01381.creator: D. Rogantini, E. Costantini, M. Mehdipour, L. Kuiper, P. Ranalli, L.B.F.M. Waters
arxiv-2012-01381.description: Abstract Context. High ionisation lines in the soft X-ray band are generally associated to either interstellar hot gas along the line of sight or to photoionised gas intrinsic to the source. In the low-mass X-ray binary 4U 1820-30, the nature of these lines is not well understood. Aims.

arxiv-2104-06380.title: The General Adversary Bound: A Survey
arxiv-2104-06380.creator: Lily Li, Morgan Shirley
arxiv-2104-06380.description: Abstract Ben Reichardt showed in a series of results that the general adversary bound of a function characterizes its quantum query complexity. This survey seeks to aggregate the background and definitions necessary to understand the proof. Notable among these are the lower bound proof, span programs, witness size, and semi-definite programs.

arxiv-2112-14290.title: On n n -pre-Lie algebras and dendrification of n n -Lie algebras
arxiv-2112-14290.creator: Taoufik Chtioui , Atef Hajjaji , Sami Mabrouk and Abdenacer Makhlouf 1. University of Sfax, Faculty of Sciences Sfax, BP 1171, 3038 Sfax, Tunisia2. University of Gafsa, Faculty of Sciences Gafsa, 2112 Gafsa, Tunisia3. IRIMAS - Département de Mathématiques, 6, rue des frères Lumière, F-68093 Mulhouse
arxiv-2112-14290.description: Abstract The main purpose of this paper is to introduce the notion of n n -L-dendriform algebra which can be seen as a dendrification of n n -pre-Lie algebras by means of 𝒪 \mathcal{O} -operators. We investigate the representation theory of n n -pre-Lie algebras and provide some related constructions.

arxiv-2205-04274.title: Detecting and Understanding Harmful Memes: A Survey
arxiv-2205-04274.creator: Shivam Sharma, Firoj Alam, Md. Shad Akhtar, Dimitar Dimitrov, Giovanni Da San Martino, Hamed Firooz, Alon Halevy, Fabrizio Silvestri, Preslav Nakov, Tanmoy Chakraborty
arxiv-2205-04274.description: Abstract The automatic identification of harmful content online is of major concern for social media platforms, policymakers, and society. Researchers have studied textual, visual, and audio content, but typically in isolation. Yet, harmful content often combines multiple modalities, as in the case of memes, which are of particular interest due to their viral nature.

arxiv-2406-10032.title: GASTLI
arxiv-2406-10032.creator: L. Acuña, L. Kreidberg, M. Zhai, P. Mollière
arxiv-2406-10032.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by L. Acuña, L. Kreidberg, M. Zhai, P. Mollière. The metal mass fractions of gas giants are a powerful tool to constrain their formation mechanisms and evolution. The metal content is inferred by comparing mass and radius measurements with interior structure and evolution models. In the midst of the JWST, CHEOPS, TESS, and the forthcoming PLATO era, we are at the brink of obtaining unprecedented precision in radius, age and atmospheric metallicity measurements.

arxiv-2406-15318.title: Global existence of solutions to a nonlocal equation with degenerate anisotropic diffusion
arxiv-2406-15318.creator: Maria Eckardt and Anna Zhigun
arxiv-2406-15318.description: Abstract Global existence of very weak solutions to a non-local diffusion-advection-reaction equation is established under no-flux boundary conditions in higher dimensions. The equation features degenerate myopic diffusion and nonlocal adhesion and is an extension of a mass-conserving model recently derived in [ 21 ] .

arxiv-2409-04023.title: Stability of moving Néel walls in ferromagnetic thin films
arxiv-2409-04023.creator: Antonio Capella, Christof Melcher, Lauro Morales, Ramón G. Plaza
arxiv-2409-04023.description: Abstract . This paper studies moving 180-degree Néel walls in ferromagnetic thin films under the reduced model for the in-plane magnetization proposed by Capella, Melcher and Otto [ 5 ] , in the case when a sufficiently weak external magnetic field is applied.

arxiv-2501-05775.title: STHFL: Spatio-Temporal Heterogeneous Federated Learning
arxiv-2501-05775.creator: Shunxin Guo, Hongsong Wang, Shuxia Lin, Xu Yang, Xin Geng
arxiv-2501-05775.description: Abstract Federated learning is a new framework that protects data privacy and allows multiple devices to cooperate in training machine learning models. Previous studies have proposed multiple approaches to eliminate the challenges posed by non-iid data and inter-domain heterogeneity issues. However, they ignore the spatio-temporal heterogeneity formed by different data distributions of increasing task data in the intra-domain.

arxiv-2503-16467.title: Enhancing Explainability with Multimodal Context Representations for Smarter Robots DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.14930029 Conference: 3rd Workshop on Explainability in Human-Robot Collaboration at HRI ’25; March 3, 2025; Melbourne, Australia The 3rd Workshop on Explainability in Human-Robot Collaboration at
arxiv-2503-16467.creator: Anargh Viswanath, Lokesh Veeramacheneni, Hendrik Buschmeier
arxiv-2503-16467.description: Abstract . Artificial Intelligence (AI) has significantly advanced in recent years, driving innovation across various fields, especially in robotics. Even though robots can perform complex tasks with increasing autonomy, challenges remain in ensuring explainability and user-centered design for effective interaction.

arxiv-2509-19631.title: Advancing speech summarization in Multi-modal LLMs with Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2509-19631.creator: Shaoshi Ling, Gang Liu, Guoli Ye, Jinyu Li
arxiv-2509-19631.description: Abstract Speech summarization (SSum) is a critical component of spoken content understanding, particularly in the era of rapidly growing spoken and audiovisual data. Recent advances in multi-modal large language models (MLLMs), leveraging the power of LLMs, enable generating textual summaries directly from speech without intermediate transcriptions, while supporting controllable styles and zero-shot generalization.

arxiv-2512-13530.title: Actively Learning Joint Contours of Multiple Computer Experiments
arxiv-2512-13530.creator: Shih-Ni Prim, Kevin R. Quinlan, Paul Hawkins, Jagadeesh Movva, Annie S. Booth
arxiv-2512-13530.description: Abstract Contour location—the process of sequentially training a surrogate model to identify the design inputs that result in a pre-specified response value from a single computer experiment—is a well-studied active learning problem. Here, we tackle a related but distinct problem: identifying the input configuration that returns pre-specified values of multiple independent computer experiments simultaneously.

pmc-12454353.title: Associations between apparent temperatures and emergency ambulance calls in Wuxi, China: a time series analysis
pmc-12454353.creator: Chao Yang, Xiuzhu Li, Wanjun Zhang, Yiru Tao, Pengfei Zhu, Chuncheng Lu, Weijie Zhou, Xinliang Ding
pmc-12454353.description: Inappropriate apparent temperature (AT) is a major global threat to human health. Although the association between temperature and health has been studied extensively, limited evidence regarding emergency ambulance calls (EACs) is available. Daily emergency department visit records, meteorological data, and air pollutant data were obtained from 1 January 2014 to 31 December 2019.

pmc-12617134.title: ΟΑ2060. Micromobility vehicles practice and accidents: Analysis of 2021 and 2024 French Health Barometer
pmc-12617134.creator: M P Chaffard Luçon, L M Paget, A Gautier, N Soullier, L Guldner
pmc-12617134.description: BackgroundIn recent years, the expansion of micromobility vehicles (MMVs) in major French cities has been accompanied by an increase in serious road accidents, and in severe injuries. This study aims to examine the profile of MMVs users and accident victims in mainland France based on the 2021 and 2024 Health Barometer.MethodsThe French Health Barometer is a repeated cross-sectional survey.

pmc-13009505.title: The association between systemic inflammation markers and breast cancer
pmc-13009505.creator: SiQi Zhang, Ran Li, CuiTing Chen, Miao Miao Liu, JiaFeng Tang, Xiang Li
pmc-13009505.description: Breast cancer is one of the most common malignant tumors in women worldwide. Inflammation plays an important role in the occurrence and development of breast cancer. This study aimed to evaluate the association between inflammatory markers and breast cancer prevalence and explore their potential biomarker value.

pmc-13374434.title: Short-term oral antibiotic discontinuation and its predictors among outpatients of public hospitals in Eastern Ethiopia: a prospective follow-up study
pmc-13374434.creator: Tilahun Tadesse Demeke, Tigist Gashaw, Tewodros Assefa, Ammas Siraj Mohammed, Abera Jambo, Dumessa Edessa
pmc-13374434.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveTo assess the prevalence of discontinuation of short-term oral antibiotic therapy and to identify its predictors among patients attending outpatient department pharmacy units of public hospitals in Harar, Eastern Ethiopia.DesignFacility-based prospective follow-up study.SettingAll public hospitals in Harar, Eastern Ethiopia.ParticipantsA total of 422 patients who received short-term oral antibiotics from Hiwot Fana Comprehensive Specialized Hospital (HFCSH) and Jugal General Hospital (JGH) from 20 January to 20 April 2024 were recruited using a systematic random sampling technique.

pmc-13689833.title: Guided tissue regeneration for severe periodontal disease in dogs: A retrospective study
pmc-13689833.creator: Chul Park, Md. Mahbubur Rahman, Kwangil Han, Inseong Jeong, Namsoo Kim
pmc-13689833.description: Clinical evidence on guided tissue regeneration (GTR) in dogs with advanced periodontal defects is limited. This retrospective study aimed to evaluate the clinical and radiographic outcomes and tooth survival after GTR in dogs with severe periodontal disease. The medical records of 67 dogs with 129 treated teeth/sites in total were reviewed.
